title: How to organise the bookshelf and reference zone | Home Office
description:
Hold the reference you genuinely reach for, at the height you reach for it from.

This is the Bookshelf and Reference Zone in the Home Office. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Working reference at seated eye level from the desk chair, heavy binders and box files on the bottom two shelves, a bookend closing each group, a hand's width of empty shelf left at the end of every row, and the unit screwed to the wall.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take every book, binder, and manual off the shelves.
Straighten: Group by why you reach: working reference at eye level from where you sit, occasional reading at standing heig
Shine: Dust from the top shelf down with a dry cloth, wipe the front edge of each shelf, and vacuum the top edges of
Safety: Screw the unit into the wall studs, and move the box files, binders, and any framed glass award off the high s
Standardize: A bookend closes every group, and a hand's width of empty shelf stays at the end of each row.
Sustain: When you finish a book or close out a project binder, it does not go back on the shelf by reflex.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every shelf keeps a hand's width of empty space, and heavy binders and box files never live above head height.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/home-office-the-bookshelf-and-reference-zone.html
